modelNotes: Minutes Engine 1.1 uses player-pool status plus season, last 5, and last 10 minutes from NBA history.
Unknown starters retain their historical minutes baseline and are not treated as confirmed bench players.
Missing injury information does not mean a player is cleared; publication eligibility requires confirmed game status and role.
Roles are Core Starter, Starter, Rotation, Bench, Deep Bench, and Inactive.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Thompson (knee) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.
injury.detail: The star guard is missing the back end of this back-to-back set Monday and is likely facing a short-term absence. Reed Sheppard stands out as a strong streaming option for fantasy managers Monday.

injury.shortComment: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Smart, who was ejected from Wednesday's game for punching Charles Bassey, will begin serving his suspension Friday night against the Jazz, meaning he'll be eligible to return Wednesday versus Indiana. Bruce Thornton and Reed Sheppard should be in line for more minutes while Smart serves his three-game ban.

injury.shortComment: Larsson won't play in Monday's game against the Rockets due to an illness, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
injury.detail: Larsson, who came down with an illness last week, is a spectator for a third consecutive contest Monday. His continued absence should create another start for Myron Gardner and more playing time for Andrew Wiggins off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Adams (calf) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.
injury.detail: The veteran big man is sitting out the second half of this back-to-back set. Tari Eason should see an uptick in playing time in the frontcourt for the Rockets on Monday.

injury.shortComment: Dunn (thumb) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Denver.
injury.detail: Dunn is in danger of missing the second leg of this back-to-back set due to right thumb soreness. If the 23-year-old forward is unable to suit up, Koa Peat and Jordan Goodwin would be candidates for increased burn. Over his last five games, Dunn has averaged 4.8 points, 5.0 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 1.0 steals in 21.0 minutes per showing.

injury.shortComment: Phillips (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against Dallas.
injury.detail: Phillips will shake off his questionable tag for Wednesday's regular-season opener. However, the two-way player isn't likely to be part of the Rockets' rotation.

injury.shortComment: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: The fact that Bona needed to see a specialist suggests the injury may be more significant than initially thought, and he'll remain sidelined for at least the next several games. Even when healthy, the big man has seen his role shrink with Joel Embiid (foot) back in the rotation, averaging just 0.7 points, 1.7 rebounds and 1.0 blocks in four appearances outside of his 25-minute effort against the Pistons in late October. In Bona's absence, Jabari Walker could see a few more minutes as Philadelphia's backup center.

injury.shortComment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
injury.detail: Edwards underwent debridement surgery in Minnesota, though the team did not provide a timetable for his return. The star guard is expected to make a full recovery, with additional updates coming as he progresses through rehabilitation. Based on previous reporting from ESPN's Shams Charania, Edwards could miss up to two months. Edwards was off to a scorching start this season, averaging 33.3 points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 2.0 steals across four appearances.

injury.shortComment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
injury.detail: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.

injury.shortComment: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.
injury.detail: Mathurin will miss a second straight game and his third over the last four outings due to plantar fasciitis in his left foot. Jordan Poole and Jaron Pierre Jr. will continue to get extended run with Mathurin on the shelf.

injury.shortComment: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
injury.detail: Williams has been diagnosed with a hamstring strain in the aftermath of Monday's game against the Pelicans, and his status for Golden State's upcoming five-game road trip is in serious doubt. With Williams facing an extended absence, the Warriors are likely to lean more on De'Anthony Melton in the backourt.

injury.shortComment: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.
injury.detail: McGowens will miss a third consecutive outing due to an infection in his left elbow. Jaron Pierre Jr. will continue earning extra minutes off the Pelicans' bench with McGowens and Bennedict Mathurin (foot) both sidelined.

injury.shortComment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: The rookie forward went down during Wednesday's loss to the Spurs, and he now needs surgery to repair a fractured right hand. More pressure will likely fall on Josh Giddey going forward, while the likes of Tre Jones and Isaac Okoro will have a chance for added streaming value.

injury.shortComment: Youngblood (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Timberwolves.
injury.detail: Youngblood will miss a third straight game due to a right foot bone bruise. His next opportunity to suit up comes Tuesday against the Timberwolves.

injury.shortComment: Capela (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.
injury.detail: The veteran big man's next chance to return from an ankle sprain comes Wednesday in Indiana. Tari Eason should continue to see a bump in playing time in the frontcourt for the Rockets on Monday.

injury.shortComment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
injury.detail: This was the expectation after the star guard requested a trade from the Pelicans earlier Friday. Given his standing with the club, Murray can be tentatively considered doubtful for future contests while New Orleans tries to find him another home.

injury.shortComment: Barlow (back) will be re-evaluated later in the week and is thought to be nearing his 2026-27 season debut, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Barlow has yet to take the court this season due to a back injury, but he's trending in the right direction. He was spotted participating in shootaround Thursday, and if all goes well during his re-evaluation, the team could have additional news on when he'll make his season debut.

injury.shortComment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.

injury.shortComment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.
injury.detail: Mobley is set to miss his third straight game Monday since suffering the injury, and he's slated to miss at least the next week while on the mend. The Cavs should have a better idea on when he'll return to the court as he begins to progress through the treatment and rehab phase.

injury.shortComment: Jackson will undergo surgery to repair the broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot and is set to miss significant time.
injury.detail: The Grizzlies will release a timeline for Jackson's return to basketball activities after he undergoes surgery, though he's facing a lengthy absence. With the 22-year-old forward on the shelf, Taylor Hendricks and Jerami Grant are candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Stewart is out for Monday's game against the Wizards due to an illness.
injury.detail: The big man can be considered day-to-day ahead of Wednesday's meeting in Cleveland. A big workload could be in store for Zach Edey (ankle) if he's able to play for the Grizzlies on Monday.

injury.shortComment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
injury.detail: With Nelson still in recovery mode from the left ankle surgery he underwent this summer, his path back to game action remains delayed for the early part of the season. The rookie big man is on a two-way contract with the Magic, so his short-term absence mainly affects his developmental timeline rather than Orlando's regular rotation.

injury.shortComment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.
injury.detail: Morant was initially given a four-week timetable after he suffered a Grade 2 left hamstring strain on Oct. 30. It sounds like he's making solid progress, though it would be surprising to see him beat that timetable given the tricky nature of hamstring injuries. Scoot Henderson will continue to start in his absence and there will be more minutes available for Jrue Holiday.

injury.shortComment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
injury.detail: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. That leaves Watkins in serious jeopardy of missing most, if not all, of the 2026-27 season, and it remains to be seen if the team will continue keeping him around on a two-way roster spot while he's injured.

injury.shortComment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.
injury.detail: Clark suffered a right hamstring strain during Saturday's 117-106 loss to Chicago. He played three minutes as a result of the injury, and he's now slated to miss at least two weeks and will be re-evaluated at that time. Terrence Shannon Jr. and Bones Hyland will see increased playing time off the bench in Clark's absence.

injury.shortComment: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Chicago.
injury.detail: Tyson was downgraded to doubtful earlier in the day, and the team has since reported that he'll be held out of Monday's action due to right ankle injury management. Look for Meleek Thomas, Tyrese Proctor and Tristan Enaruna to see more run in Tyson's absence.

injury.shortComment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Butler, who underwent surgery after suffering the injury Jan. 19, has progressed to individual court work but still has several rehabilitation milestones to clear. His next step involves landing comfortably after a game-speed jump. Coach Steve Kerr is hopeful Butler can rejoin Golden State for the latter portion of the season, though no official return date has been announced. The 37-year-old forward remains a significant part of the Warriors' plans and could provide a substantial boost during the second half of the campaign.

injury.shortComment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: Isaac's 2026-27 season debut will have to wait, as he's still working his way back from a left knee injury. He should be considered week-to-week until Orlando provides a clear update for his return.

injury.shortComment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
injury.detail: The forward underwent surgery Wednesday to address a fractured foot, and the Wizards hope Champagnie will be ready to return at some time around the All-Star break in February. The likes of Bilal Coulibaly, Tre Johnson and Bub Carrington will all be asked to help pick up the slack for the foreseeable future.

injury.shortComment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
injury.detail: Porzingis said he was looking forward to joining the Warriors, but his body didn't respond the way he wanted it too during his ramp-up process before the season. Additionally, he said he will work with the Warriors on a solution that "makes sense." Porzingis is making this decision to prioritize his health and will hopefully turn a corner soon on that front.

injury.shortComment: James (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Nets.
injury.detail: As expected, James won't play in the second half of Philly's back-to-back set after finishing Sunday's 131-124 victory over Indiana with 15 points (5-8 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 5-6 FT), seven rebounds, 11 assists and one block across 33 minutes. The veteran superstar has yet to play in both halves of a back-to-back set this season, and that trend is unlikely to change. Dean Wade and Jabari Walker are candidates for increased roles in James' absence.

injury.shortComment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Moody has been limited to individual court work, but team sources indicate he's ahead of Jimmy Butler (knee) in the rehabilitation process and is expected to return before the veteran forward. The 24-year-old still has several recovery checkpoints to complete, and Golden State has not established an official timetable. His eventual return would help replenish a Warriors wing rotation that will open the season without both Moody and Butler.

injury.shortComment: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
injury.detail: This is a tough blow for the forward and there's no guarantee he's cleared right away when he's re-evaluated in three-to-four weeks. Tomlin wasn't projected to crack the rotation ahead of Opening Night and was penciled in to be an emergency depth option.

injury.shortComment: Queta (rest) won't play in Monday's game against the Magic, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.
injury.detail: The big man is sitting out the second half of this back-to-back set Monday, but he should be good to go for Wednesday's showdown in Denver. Mitchell Robinson is the most likely choice to replace Queta in the starting lineup, while Luka Garza should see a sizable chunk of the center minutes.

injury.shortComment: Jovic (illness) is out for Monday's game against Houston.
injury.detail: Jovic was added to the injury report as questionable due to an illness earlier in the day Monday, and the club has since determined that he won't be able to give it a go. Klay Thompson and Bobby Portis could pick up a few additional minutes in Jovic's absence, though the impact to Miami's rotation should be minimal.

injury.shortComment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
injury.detail: Penda suffered a partially torn hamstring in the preseason and can still be considered week-to-week moving forward. With the second-year forward and Paolo Banchero (ankle) both sidelined, Tristan da Silva and Jamal Cain should continue seeing increased minutes.

injury.shortComment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Banchero left during Friday's loss against the Timberwolves due to an ankle injury, and follow-up tests have confirmed a high-ankle sprain for the fifth-year forward. With an extended absence expected, the Magic will have to rely more heavily on Franz Wagner and Desmond Bane offensively, and Tristan da Silva figures to be the top candidate to enter the Magic's starting lineup for as long as Banchero is sidelined.

injury.shortComment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
injury.detail: Beekman is set for an extended absence, with his re-evaluation timeline suggesting he could remain sidelined beyond the initial three-week window. The injury further limits Washington's backcourt depth, though Beekman's absence is unlikely to have a significant impact on standard fantasy leagues.

injury.shortComment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Saunders is still on the mend from a torn right ACL that he suffered during his final year at BYU. However, he has been cleared for on-court activities and will be allowed to practice with the Grizzlies now that he's officially signed with the team.

injury.shortComment: Merrill (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bulls.
injury.detail: Merrill is set to miss his sixth consecutive game due to a right elbow injury. With the majority of the Cavs' starting lineup expected to return versus Chicago, Tyrese Proctor and Meleek Thomas should continue to see the majority of Merrill's vacated minutes in the backcourt.

injury.shortComment: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.
injury.detail: Pippen hasn't played since Oct. 29 due to a lumbar disc herniation and remains without a firm timetable to return.  Cam Spencer and Javon Small will likely continue seeing increased playing time in Pippen's absence.

injury.shortComment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
injury.detail: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for Vit Krejci and Jeremy Sochan to compete for bench minutes during camp.

injury.shortComment: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Curry suffered the injury early during Wednesday's loss to the Rockets, with head coach Steve Kerr saying after the game that the superstar point guard "tweaked" something in his abdominal area. Curry has never dealt with an injury of this nature, so the Warriors, who are off to a hot start spearheaded by Rookie of the Year candidate Yaxel Lendeborg, will likely proceed with caution. Brandin Podziemski, Brandon Williams (hamstring), De'Anthony Melton, Will Richard and Gary Payton (knee) are all candidates for increased roles until Curry is cleared to play again.

injury.shortComment: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.
injury.detail: Awaka will miss a fourth consecutive game due a disc irritation in his back. His next chance to suit up will come against the Nets on Wednesday.

injury.shortComment: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.
injury.detail: Watford will miss a fifth consecutive contest due to a right ankle sprain. He remains without a clear return timetable.

injury.shortComment: Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.
injury.detail: Murphy is set to miss a fifth consecutive game while he works his way back from bilateral patellar tendinopathy. His next chance to suit up will come against the Pistons on Wednesday. Saddiq Bey will likely remain in the starting unit for as long as Murphy is sidelined.

injury.shortComment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.
injury.detail: Vukcevic has yet to make his season debut due to a left hip injury. He can be considered week-to-week until the Wizards offer an update on his progress.

injury.shortComment: Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Wizards.
injury.detail: Jerome will miss a second straight matchup while nursing right hip soreness. Cam Spencer could receive another chance to start at point guard in Jerome's absence. The Virginia product's next opportunity to return will arrive Wednesday in Cleveland.

injury.shortComment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
injury.detail: Krejci suffered the ankle injury in last Wednesday's win over the Suns and is set to miss an extended period after undergoing surgery. With the 26-year-old and Ja Morant (hamstring) both on the shelf, Jrue Holiday and Sidy Cissoko should continue seeing increased minutes.

injury.shortComment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
injury.detail: Strawther suffered the injury in Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers. The 24-year-old has appeared in 172 regular-season games for the Nuggets since entering the league in 2023, averaging 7.1 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 16.2 minutes per contest. He was in line to compete for an expanded role during the 2026-27 campaign. While that may be the case once Strawther is cleared to suit up, Tyus Jones and potentially Ryan Nembhard are candidates to receive more minutes in the interim.

injury.shortComment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.
